scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Enter your email, and we'll send you a four digit code to verify it.

scenes.label: dashboard
scenes.line: From your dashboard, tap New Order.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order starts out empty. This time you are booking for somebody else.

scenes.label: party-members
scenes.line: Invite a new party member, with their name and their email.

scenes.label: member-added
scenes.line: They are on the order now.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Search the catalogue, or open a collection to see what is inside it.

scenes.label: pick-the-dates
scenes.line: Choose the pickup date, then the return date. {0.3} Their gear is held for those days.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Now answer a few questions for them, so we can have the gear ready before they arrive. {0.3} Their height, their boot size, their skill level, their weight and their age. {0.3} Then agree to the terms and save.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: Enter your card details to finish the rental.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: You rented nothing yourself, and their gear is booked and waiting.
